title: Ajoo Protocol
tagline: Novel Defi Solutions on Different Savings, Uncollateralized micro-lending, micro-insurance and DCA investments.
description: Ajoo Finance is a web3 personal finance platform offering diverse savings solutions especially our novel circle savings, micro-investments, uncollateralized lending services, custodial features for charity GoFundMe setup and family trust funds, and micro-insurance options. It emphasizes cross-chain compatibility and KYC verification for efficient and secure interactions.
how_its_made:
On the blockchain side, Ajoo Finance utilizes smart contracts written in Solidity (for Ethereum and compatible networks) to implement core functionalities such as savings, lending, and investment mechanisms. These smart contracts are deployed on secure and scalable blockchains, ensuring transparency and immutability of transactions. The smart contracts also integrate openzeppelin, kintoId, Chainlink CCIP and VRF, Uniswap, Aave and a few others.

Ajoo Finance's frontend is built using modern web technologies, primarily leveraging frameworks like React/Next for a responsive and dynamic user interface. Also, the web3 auth kit and rainbow kit are used, together with ethers.js.
